sun.title: Meat Sampler + Bread Basket
sun.detail: Chicken grill, chicken tikka, kola urundai and tandoori shrimp, with naan, garlic naan, bun parotta and chapatti for the table.

mon.title: Any Two Veg Dosas + Madras Filter Coffee
mon.detail: Pick any two from the vegetarian dosa list and finish with two tumblers of Madras filter coffee.
mon.terms: Dine-in and takeout. Not combinable with other offers.

tue.title: Idly & Medu Vada, Half Price After 9 PM
tue.detail: Steamed idly, golden medu vada, sambar and a duo of chutneys — the way Madras eats after the late show.

wed.title: Thambi Vilas Mutton Biryani
wed.detail: Seeraga samba premium rice cooked Dindigul style, with mutton. Our most-ordered biryani.
wed.terms: One per guest. Dine-in and takeout.

thu.title: Gobi Manchurian — Buy One, Get One
thu.detail: Fried cauliflower sautéed with chilli, garlic, ginger and soy. Order one, the second is on us.
thu.terms: Dine-in only. Second plate of equal or lesser value.

fri.title: Late Dosa Hour
fri.detail: All seventeen dosai, made to order straight off the iron — right up to last orders.

sat.title: Whole Signature Grill Chicken + Breads
sat.detail: The whole rotisserie bird in our secret Southern Indian spice blend, with a bread basket and salad.

promos.title: Pongal Buffet
promos.detail: Ven pongal, sakkarai pongal, sugarcane, vadai and the full harvest table — served all afternoon.

promos.title: Seafood Sampler Night
promos.detail: Anchovies, pomfret, tandoori shrimp, calamari and vanjeeram on one platter — the whole coast in a sitting.
